_label: FIXTURE: hypothetical demo meeting written from the team's real build decisions on 2026-11-15. Not a Wispr Notetaker record. Participants consented to its use.

passages.speaker: Charan
passages.text: Agenda: Kaam Ki Baat demo at 4. Who owns what, and what's still open.

passages.speaker: Charan
passages.text: Decision: the Leader Desk opens only on my laptop, with Touch ID. A head turn or the camera only selects an agent, it never proves who I am.

passages.speaker: Harsh
passages.text: Agreed. I'll use Team Memory and the Code Navigator from my side.

passages.speaker: Charan
passages.text: Decision: the agent says saved only after the update is read back from the store. A timeout is a failure.

passages.speaker: Charan
passages.text: Harsh, can you run the three test calls, each over 45 seconds, and write the evaluation note after each one?

passages.speaker: Harsh
passages.text: Yes, I'll take the three calls and the evaluation notes.

passages.speaker: Charan
passages.text: I'll handle the leader approvals during the demo.

passages.speaker: Harsh
passages.text: Should the code graph agent sit on the left side? It explains how it found the code.

passages.speaker: Charan
passages.text: Maybe. Let's decide after the first call.

passages.speaker: Charan
passages.text: Someone should record the demo film before four. Not sure who yet.

passages.speaker: Harsh
passages.text: Open question: do we freeze the code at 3:30 or 3:45?
